== Ingredients ==
*1 slab St. Louis [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] spareribs
*5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Barbecue Rub|Barbecue Rub]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] apple [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
*¼ cup blackstrap [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]]
*¼ cup light molasses
*2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
*Large hickory chunks

== Procedure ==
#Massage ribs with the barbecue rub. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
#Combine remaining ingredients except for hickory in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over high heat until reduced by ½.
#Place hickory chunks in firebox of 250°F (120°C) [[Cookbook:Smoker|smoker]].
#Place ribs in smoker and cook, brushing often with tomato mixture and changing the hickory chunks as needed, for 5–6 hours.
#Brush ribs generously with mixture and [[Cookbook:Grilling|grill]] on high heat, brushing repeatedly until well-browned on both sides.
#Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.
